sql: SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)||'-'||split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) AS ev, string_agg(split_part(market_ticker,'-',3)||':'||right(strategy,1)||':'||left(status,1)||':'||coalesce(round(pnl::numeric,2)::text,'-'),' ' ORDER BY market_ticker,strategy) legs FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Rmmsell1','Rmmsell2') AND (created_at >= '2026-10-12 09:00' OR market_ticker LIKE '%26OCT10MEDSVR%' OR (pnl < 0 AND closed_at >= '2026-10-12 10:40')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
